items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: This, uh, Tien Collin, this is really, the title is Pussy Pussy Pussy.

ctx.x: And you never changed your name on those?

No. No. I told you on this one, this is interesting. This, uh, Tien Collin, this is really, the title is Pussy Pussy Pussy. And, uh, there was a refrain that was unmistakable as to, uh, symbolism. And on the back then, we wanted to put something that would be a little bit better, higher status. And we had a good arrangement of Gin Mill Blues, so that was what we put on the back, the B side of it was Gin Mill Blues, which we thought wouldn't sell anyway. I mean, it didn't really. Nothing, nothing could compete…
They gotta write down and tell him about it. We're waiting. Uh, you, you stopped playing with the Cotterians. You stopped playing with the country bands in about what year?
